name: cl-social-contributions
description: Chile social contributions of independent workers (trabajadores independientes) for income of 2026, settled in Operación Renta, año tributario (AT) 2027. Covers who must contribute (DL 3.500 art. 89: art. 42 No. 2 honorarios and partners of societies of professionals) and who is exempt, the annual base of 80% of gross honorarios with its floor of four minimum monthly incomes and its ceiling of 12 x 90 UF, the pension contribution of 10% plus the AFP commission, the 7% health contribution, the SIS, work-accident insurance under Ley 16.744 (0.90% plus the activity rate) and the 0.03% SANNA contribution, the choice between total coverage and partial coverage at 90% for AT 2027 (Ley 21.133), the rule that limits the pension contribution to what the boleta withholding leaves, the order in which the withholding pays each item (art. 92 G), the coverage year from 1 July 2027 and the voluntary contributions of Ley 21.735. Trigger on: cotizaciones independientes, boleta de honorarios cotización,
